name: Sap Touch
description: Press a palm warm with rising sap-like qi onto a wound and feel the flesh begin to grow.

name: Vital Sense
description: Read the living pulse of the whole body and learn where its growth is stunted by injury.

name: Frond Screen
description: Spread a screen of layered green qi over a patient like leaves over a nest.

name: Vital Mend
description: Mend a wound with qi rich in vitality so new tissue of an ally or the self grows in as it closes.

name: Growth Purge
description: Purge a wasting taint with a surge of growth that crowds corrupt tissue out of an ally.

name: Sprouting Rally
description: Coax fresh vigour to sprout in the muscles of a drained ally so that strength builds from within.

name: Thriving Recovery
description: Make a battered body thrive again by feeding every wound a double stream of mending and vitality.

name: Rooted Restoration
description: Root the healer's qi deep in the bones of an ally and mend outward from that anchor.

name: Leafward Remedy
description: Pour an evergreen remedy into an ally that renews tissue as fast as injury destroys it.

name: Verdant Renewal
description: streams: Healing + Life; fuse repair and growth in one surge that restores an ally and regrows what was lost.

name: Sprig Touch
description: Lay a green-bright fingertip on a scrape so a fresh layer of skin sprigs over it.

name: Rootward Sense
description: Send qi down through a body like a root to find which tissue is failing to feed.

name: Bough Guard
description: Bend a springy bough of qi over a patient to take a blow and give.

name: Seedling Warmth
description: Warm a wound as a seedling is warmed so the flesh of an ally stirs and grows.

name: Tendril Mend
description: Send tendrils of qi across a torn gap in the flesh and let them thicken into new tissue.

name: Pollen Purge
description: Scatter a fine haze of cleansing qi through a body to catch and carry off airborne taint.

name: Green Rally
description: Flush a drained ally with green vitality so colour and strength return in a single breath.

name: Sapflow Lift
description: Raise the flow of life through a weakened limb until the muscle plumps and the pain ebbs.

name: Flourishing Recovery
description: Let healing and vitality braid together and run through a wounded ally until every injury flourishes into health.

name: Living Revival
description: Pour living qi into an ally whose heart has just stopped and let vitality restart it.

name: Bountiful Remedy
description: Give a bountiful remedy that mends and regrows at once and leaves the ally better fed and fuller of life.

name: Lifebloom Restoration
description: streams: Healing + Life; bloom a flower of fused qi on the injury and let it knit lost flesh back in full.

name: Seep Touch
description: Let a slow seep of qi well from the palm and soak into a hurt of an ally or the self.

name: Source Sense
description: Trace a patient's strength back to its source and see how much of it is still flowing.

name: Fount Screen
description: Raise a rising curtain of water-bright qi over a patient as a fountain's spray.

name: Welling Mend
description: Let healing well up through a deep wound from beneath so it fills and closes from below.

name: Spring Rinse
description: Rinse a body of taint with fresh spring qi that carries the foulness out at every pore.

name: Quickening Rally
description: Quicken the dim qi of a faltering ally with a burst from the healer's Core.

name: Unfailing Restoration
description: Draw on a source that does not run dry and restore a wounded ally for hours without tiring.

name: Wellborn Revival
description: Draw a surge from the wellspring of the Core and raise an ally in the moments after the heart fails.

name: Fountainhead Remedy
description: Open the fountainhead of the Core and pour a remedy through an ally that heals the whole body.

name: Living Wellspring
description: streams: Healing + Life; open a standing wellspring at the healer's feet that mends and renews every ally around it.

name: Deathless Touch
description: Make a touch so steady with life that a wound barely bleeds under the palm of the healer.

name: Spark Sense
description: Hunt for the last spark of life in a failing body and mark where it still burns.

name: Unfading Screen
description: Hold a screen of enduring qi round a dying ally that wears away no matter how it is struck.

name: Everwarm Breath
description: Breathe unfailing warmth into a cold ally so the lungs and blood take up life.

name: Unfading Mend
description: Mend a wound so deep that its closing leaves no weakness in the flesh of an ally or the self.

name: Spark Rekindle
description: Feed a dying spark of vitality in the chest of an ally until it catches and burns steadily.

name: Undying Purge
description: Purge the slow-killing taint of a deathly curse from an ally with relentless living qi.

name: Lasting Rally
description: Anchor a stable surge of vigour in the dantian of an ally so it fades only after hours.

name: Deathless Recovery
description: Hold a mortally wounded ally to life with mending and vitality until the injuries are closed.

name: Immortal Cleansing
description: Cleanse an ally of even the most deathly curse with a flood of unending clean qi.

name: Undying Revival
description: Refuse the death of an ally in the instant after it comes and force life back with fused qi.

name: Everliving Remedy
description: Pour an everliving remedy into an ally that renews flesh faster than the wound can spread.

name: Deathless Bloom
description: streams: Healing + Life; bloom a fused flower of qi over the fallen that mends the body and recalls the breath.

name: Everliving Wellspring
description: streams: Healing + Life; raise a source of fused qi that keeps every wounded ally mending as long as it flows.
